correctness.rationale: Independent census of all 32768 simple graph edge subsets finds exactly 1858 admissible faces (15,105,395,735,537,70 nonempty f-vector), and independent oriented fixed-face Hopf traces for all 11 cycle types yield (2,1,0,0,0,0,0,8,4,0,36). Separately implemented Jacobi–Trudi signed Young-permutation characters and exact character inner products to recover five multiplicity-one Specht shapes and no others, dimensions summing to 36. Inspected original exact integer Morse verifier, its acyclic lexicographic matching (896 nonempty pairs), and its claimed unit 14-by-14 boundary determinant -1; the standalone source specifies the elimination and finite checks, but I did not reimplement that full 14-by-50 integer elimination. The known published integral Betti dimension is correctly credited. The rational character follows from Euler–Poincaré given homology concentration in degree four, which the source finite exact chain computation supplies.

value.rationale: The loopless degree-two graph complex on six vertices is a canonical small symmetric bounded-degree complex; its previously known 36-dimensional homology admits a non-obvious complete six-label action. Distinguishing all five irreducible constituents and the sole invariant line gives an independently useful exact equivariant invariant, not merely recomputation of its known Betti number.
